events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering Elvis
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. 49 years since Elvis Presley left the building for the last time. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, commemorating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, which 007 is your favourite, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon or Beatles track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost the Queen legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Freddie moment?
